name: Mailgun
solves: Provides the official Mailgun JavaScript SDK for sending, validating, and tracking email via Mailgun's HTTP API, including domains, templates, mailing lists, and event webhooks.
best_for: Apps needing a mature ESP API for transactional and moderate-volume outbound email
Teams that want email validation, mailing lists, and inbound routing in one vendor
Node backends integrating Mailgun domains, templates, and delivery webhooks
Migrations from SMTP-based Nodemailer setups to an HTTP ESP
Products that already use Mailgun EU or US regions for data residency
skip_when: You want React-email-centric DX with minimal ESP surface area (consider Resend)
You need pure self-hosted sending with no ESP contract
Cost optimization at high volume points to Amazon SES on AWS
You only need a thin SMTP transport and Nodemailer is enough
You prefer Postmark's transactional-only focus and message streams model
